cases.requirement: Cold start the supported clean game with UMM 0.32.4/Harmony 2.3.6; confirm mod loads once, diagnostics match this DLL, and reload/update requires restarting.
Start combat; submit known initiative faces for the party and verify native order/modifiers without a stall.
Exercise normal, advantage and disadvantage attack rolls with known faces; verify selected face, modifiers, miss/hit/critical and native outcomes.
Submit a natural 1 for a Halfling Lucky roll; enter the replacement manually; repeat with Auto and verify the whole native step completes once.
Exercise actual Jump/Climb or BreakFree plus an ordinary ability check; confirm manual requests use the acting character and native bonuses/results.

Exercise Counterspell ability checks through both success and failure, including manual entry and Auto; verify the original failure continuation resumes, completes once and leaves no modal or frozen action.

Exercise shove success/failure with different native Athletics/Acrobatics choices, advantage/disadvantage and known attack/defender faces. Verify original contest outcome, action state and no stale input; unsupported random affinity bonuses must retain native behavior.
Exercise saving throws with Bless/Bane and a spell save; verify every requested face, advantage and native success/failure/bookkeeping.
Exercise Sleep with a known 5d8 pool including total 40; verify target selection and native pool consumption; verify fixed/auxiliary values require no phantom roll.
Cast Magic Missile with ordinary and additional damage; verify requested raw faces correspond to native dice counts and every missile resolves.
Exercise shared-area versus per-target damage, critical extra dice, healing and temporary HP; verify no batch is reused or shifted to a different form/target.
Spend a rest hit die with a known face and repeat with Auto; verify native healing bounds, spent die count, UI totals and no duplicate spending.
Cancel/dispose a pending action, change location and disable/re-enable the mod; verify only the owned prompt closes and no modal/input/awaiter remains stranded.
At ordinary and high UI scaling/resolution, inspect every prompt row, invalid input and footer; drag repeatedly and verify camera/scene commands are blocked only while the modal owns input.
With a category disabled or an unsupported native context, confirm the native roll continues without a modal; disabling mid-prompt resumes the native action safely without stealing accepted faces.

Confirm an unsupported changed game or conflicting Harmony patch is rejected/falls back with a useful message and leaves ordinary native gameplay usable; use a separate test setup, not the qualified clean installation.
Close the game, remove only the standalone mod through UMM, restart and confirm ordinary dice and input work while the clean main game DLL hash remains unchanged.
